## Ctx.renderBroadcast() method

Sends a message to multiple users in bulk.

**Signature:**

```typescript
renderBroadcast(ids: number[], languageCode: string[], keyboard?: ITInBoKb | null, data?: ITData | null, AGBaseId?: string | null, options?: ITOptReply | null, throwError?: boolean | null): Promise<{
        successCount: number;
        failedCount: number;
        totalCount: number;
    }>;
```

**Returns:**

Promise&lt;{ successCount: number; failedCount: number; totalCount: number; }&gt;

## Remarks

Automatically throttles after 30 messages to respect Telegram rate limits. Uses each user's specified language code for template rendering.

## Example


```typescript
async handleCallbackQueryData() {
  const userIds = [123456, 789012]
  const langs = ["en", "id"]
  await this.renderBroadcast(userIds, langs)
}
```
